BiblicalUsage: Geshur is a district of Syria, named 9 times in Scripture, in Joshua, 2 Samuel, and 1 Chronicles. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Geshur matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Geshur is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
